l_h1: Main headline of the landing page, the first thing a stranger sees. Database jargon (σ, JOIN, PRIMARY KEY) floats around it. Must hook, not describe. Short.
l_sub: Paragraph under the headline. Keep every promise in it: starts from zero, no prior knowledge, step by step up to multi-table queries, subqueries, window functions and proper database design; a visualizer, an instantly checked exercise and exam-style questions per topic. Also the slogan of the closing banner.
l_cta: Primary button under the headline. Starts sign-up.
l_cta2: Button at the end of the story animation, next to the ROLLBACK replay line. Starts sign-up.
l_have: Secondary button next to the primary one. Goes to sign-in. First person is fine here.
l_feat.0.1: Feature card title: animated visualizers of each operator on real tables.
l_feat.0.2: Feature card body under the title above.
l_feat.1.1: Feature card title: exercises are checked on the spot.
l_feat.1.2: Feature card body: the checker compares the result table, not the text, so any correct query is accepted.
l_feat.2.1: Feature card title: questions in the style of the exam.
l_feat.2.2: Feature card body: six options per question, real traps, explanation right after answering.
l_feat.3.1: Feature card title: progress is saved. Must NOT promise multiple devices.
l_feat.3.2: Feature card body: you continue from where you stopped.
l_how.0.0: Step 1 title (bold), stands alone with no line under it.
l_how.0.1: Empty on purpose: the step title stands alone (Raz, 2026-10-05).
l_how.1.1: Empty on purpose: the step title stands alone (Raz, 2026-10-05).
l_how.2.1: Empty on purpose: the step title stands alone (Raz, 2026-10-05).
ch_details: One-word label in the sign-up progress bar (chapter 1: name, birth date, email, password).
ch_terms: One-word label in the sign-up progress bar (chapter 2: privacy terms).
ch_done: One-word label in the sign-up progress bar (last chapter).
ch_n: Tiny label above the chapter name. {n} is a number.
dt_h: Heading of the name and birth date steps. Warm.
dt_h_acc: Heading of the email and password steps.
d_first_why: Helper line under the first name field: this is how we will address you; letters only, Hebrew or English.
d_last_why: Helper line under the last name field; this step comes right after first name.
d_birth_why: Helper line under the birth date field. Reassures that nobody sees it.
d_email_why: Helper line under the email field: the email is the login identifier and the confirmation link is sent there.
d_pass_why: Helper line under the password field: minimum 8 characters; stored as a hash, so nobody can read it, not even the site owners.
tm_why: Error shown when the student tries to continue without ticking the terms checkbox.
t_s1: Privacy summary, line 1 of 4: what is stored. Keep the facts exact.
t_s2: Privacy summary, line 2 of 4: what is NOT stored. Keep the facts exact.
t_s3: Privacy summary, line 3 of 4: only the course staff sees it, and only for the course.
t_s4: Privacy summary, line 4 of 4: deletion on request at any time, progress included.
g_consent: Checkbox label. Keep the <a> tag and its attributes exactly. Avoid gender slash forms.
g_foot: Small footnote on the sign-up card, a wink to database students: signing up is one INSERT, signing in is a SELECT, the password is stored as a hash. Keep the <code> tags.
g_working: Shown on the submit button while the request runs. The card shows a live SQL panel executing the query.
g_checking: Shown next to the email field while checking whether it is already registered.
g_free: Shown next to the email field when it is not registered yet (green).
g_err_exists: Shown next to the email field when it is already registered.
g_err_in: Sign-in failed: wrong email or password.
g_err_gen: Generic error, something failed on our side.
g_err_captcha: The CAPTCHA check was not completed.
g_blocked: Shown at sign-in when staff suspended the account. Point them to the site team.
g_forgot: Link under the password field on sign-in. First person is fine here.
g_ok_up: Message after sign-up: we sent a confirmation link to the email; click it, then sign in.
su_h: Popup title right after sign-up. {n} is the first name.
su_body: Popup body right after sign-up: a confirmation link was sent to {e}; click it, then sign in.
su_tip: Small line in the same popup, for when the email did not arrive: check spam.
in_why: Subtitle on the sign-in card for a returning student.
in_to_up: Line at the bottom of the sign-in card. The last word is a link to sign-up.
up_to_in: Line at the bottom of the sign-up card. The last word is a link to sign-in.
l_scroll: Line above the arrow at the bottom of the first screen. Invites a scroll; the story below plays itself in under a minute.
l_story_h: Big title above the story animation; once it is in view its words rise one by one. The word in the span gets a neon bar.
l_st_replay: Shown as an SQL comment ('-- ...') above the ROLLBACK; line at the end of the story, and as the label of the replay button. Plays the story again.
l_st_pause: Label of the pause button on the story player.
l_st_play: Label of the play button on the story player (also before it starts).
l_dict: The closing banner of the landing: rows of an SQL keyword and its plain meaning, revealed one by one (meanings reviewed 2026-10-07). The card loops with the chat.
l_chat_name: Name at the top of the small chat in the closing banner, where the database answers a question in SQL.
